title: Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired dish made with marinated chicken in a rich curry sauce. Serve over basmati rice or with naan bread.
instructions: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, curry powder, turmeric, cumin, salt, and black pepper for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger. Cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the marinated chicken to the saucepan and cook until browned.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the yogurt and cook until the sauce thickens.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Simmer the curry for 15-20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with cilantro and serve over basmati rice or with naan bread.
